limitations: The annual period and company boundaries are interpretations.

from_speaker: seem to be able to make

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading concerns revenue from generative-AI products, rather than the entire revenue of chipmakers, cloud conglomerates, or acquired social networks.
I interpret billions as at least USD 2 billion of realized annual revenue.
I use calendar 2025, the latest completed revenue year before publication and the year discussed in the surrounding text.
The surrounding discussion relies on press estimates, so the contract uses estimate as its basis.
The qualification about exact amounts expresses uncertainty without specifying an error threshold. It is not treated as an allegation of a particular accounting misstatement.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable annual revenue evidence shows OpenAI and Anthropic each above USD 2 billion and every other company in the intended group below that threshold.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one other company in the intended group earned USD 2 billion or more in comparable realized generative-AI revenue during the target year.
